title: Tag filter assertions pass with the tag listener disconnected

title: Root fixture can report successful backup or restore after a failed copy
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN; keep root opt-in excluded: model a failed restore cp followed by a successful sha256sum of readable hosts, or a failed backup cp with a stale readable fixed backup file.
expected: Abort before privileged apply unless backup succeeded; fail cleanup when restore fails and verify restored bytes equal the captured preimage.
observed: Separate Shell.cmd arguments are newline commands. libsu reports the final sha256sum status, hiding failed cp/chmod/chown. Digests are only printed and never compared. Restore can silently leave generated hosts installed; stale backup can mask backup failure.
fix: Check every copy/metadata step with a fail-fast command or separate results; use a unique verified backup and compare restored digest to the captured original. Preserve explicit opt-in and do not expand root runtime coverage.
test_evidence: Full 171-line fixture read; cached pinned libsu 6.0.0 CommandSource and JobTask bytecode inspected read-only: commands are newline-delimited and END_CMD captures final $?. No root shell or test executed.

area: connected tests / quick preset fixture safety
title: Ordinary preset UI test can launch a real root apply without a root opt-in
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN: run the ordinary quick-preset test on a root-capable connected test device with real models and let the immediate worker finish retrieval before teardown cancellation.
expected: An ordinary enqueue/UI fixture isolates privileged effects; only explicit guarded root smoke may write system hosts.
observed: Reset selects ROOT. The chip schedules real immediate work with no injected models or scheduler gate. Worker retrieves actual sources then resolves and applies RootModel. Teardown cancellation cannot undo an already completed hosts write; there is no hosts backup/restore.
fix: Install and restore a no-op recording AdBlockModel plus deterministic source work, or isolate execution via a test scheduler/WorkerFactory while retaining real enqueue assertions. Keep actual root writes only in the opt-in root fixture.
test_evidence: Full preset/reset fixture reads; partial production trace enqueue -> worker -> application method dispatch -> RootModel.apply/copyHostsFile. This is a conditional source-confirmed side effect, not an observed device mutation. Distinct from REL-002 UX runner device gate. No runtime performed.

title: Unavailable accessibility window silently satisfies absence checks
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN: have getRootInActiveWindow return null during the negative assertion after a route/dialog transition while the forbidden text remains on the eventual target screen.
expected: Absence is accepted only after observing the expected non-null target window; missing UI evidence retries or fails.
observed: Prefs helper returns immediately for root == null at line 141. Filter-set helper maps null root to null node at line 383 and succeeds. Prior positive checks do not guarantee the subsequent snapshot exists.
fix: Wait boundedly for a non-null expected screen/window and perform the negative assertion on that snapshot; retry null snapshots and fail on timeout. Add a null-window control for the helper.
test_evidence: Both files read fully. Null branch is explicit; no UI transition timing or runtime failure reproduced. Other positive assertions remain useful but cannot validate these negative snapshots.

title: Delete regression assertion accepts a retained disabled rule
reproduction: PROPOSED NOT RUN: replace confirmed delete with setting the target rule enabled=false and leave the row in hosts_lists.
expected: Confirmed deletion removes the persisted target rule identity.
observed: After confirm, waitForRuleCount asks for zero rows with enabled=true. countRules includes enabled=? in its WHERE clause. A retained disabled rule therefore passes the deletion assertion.
fix: Capture target row identity and assert no stored row with that identity after deletion, independently of enabled/type; keep the existing cancel-preserves-row control.
test_evidence: Full fixture source read and predicate evaluation. This is a test false-positive, not a claim that current production delete retains rows. No test or mutation run.
